title: Express Cardio Combo
description: 3-round explosive HIIT chained with an 8-round Tabata for a double-dose cardio session

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump forward for distance, absorb landing and repeat

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.instructions: Run in place, knees above hips, arms coordinated

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, hands on the floor, jump feet back, push-up, jump up

exercises.name: Skaters
exercises.instructions: Lateral jumps from foot to foot, arms swinging

exercises.name: Tuck jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump driving knees to the chest

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank, drive knees to chest alternating quickly

exercises.name: Jump squats
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with maximum jump, absorb the landing

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, rapid alternating kicks

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
